->Stainless, pure light,<-
->The sun of wisdom breaks through all darkness,<-
->Able to subdue disasters of wind and fire,<-
->Universally illuminating the world.<-
->The body of compassion is like the peal of thunder from the precepts,<-
->The mind of kindness is like a wondrous great cloud,<-
->Pouring down the dharma rain of sweet dew,<-
->Extinguishing the flames of vexation.<-
->In disputes before officials,<-
->Or in the fear of military battles,<-
->If one contemplates the power of Avalokiteshvara,<-
->All enemies will retreat and scatter.<-
->Wondrous voice, voice of the world-observer,<-
->Brahma voice, voice of the rising tide,<-
->Surpassing the voices of the world,<-
->Therefore, you must always keep it in mind.<-
->In every thought, do not harbor doubt,<-
->Avalokiteshvara, the pure and holy one,<-
->In the misery, distress, and deathly perils,<-
->Is able to act as a refuge and protector.<-
->Possessing all merits,<-
->Viewing living beings with eyes of compassion,<-
->Gathering a sea of blessings without measure,<-
->Therefore, one should bow in reverence.<-

---

->At that time, the Bodhisattva Earth-Holder rose from his seat, stepped forward, and said to the Buddha, "World-Honored One! If there are living beings who hear of this chapter on the free and unfettered deeds of Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara, and of his power to manifest his <term>pumena</term> <gloss>universal gate</gloss> and supernatural strength, you should know that the merits of these people are not small." When the Buddha spoke this chapter on the Universal Gate, eighty-four thousand living beings in the assembly all brought forth the <term>anuttara-samyak-sambodhi</term> <gloss>unsurpassed, complete, and perfect enlightenment</gloss> heart.<-

<summary>This passage concludes the verses praising the protective powers of Avalokiteshvara and records the reaction of the Bodhisattva Earth-Holder and the assembly to the teaching of the Universal Gate.</summary>
<keywords>Avalokiteshvara, Universal Gate, Earth-Holder Bodhisattva, compassion, enlightenment, merits</keywords>
